text: And yet, the war continues. Look across the veil. This is the strangest truth of fourth density.
It is the only realm besides your old one that still believes a battle is necessary.
Your world fought because it could not see. This world fights because it feels so deeply
and has not yet learned restraint. It has love, but not yet wisdom. And love without wisdom
does not know how to lay down its weapons. The higher realms want nothing to do with this war.
Only here, only now, do both sides still take up arms. On one side stand the guardians,
radiant presences who have made it their work to protect the free will of the world's below.
They wield love the way your world wields shields, as protection against enslavement,
as the defense of every soul's right to choose. And here is what makes them extraordinary.
They can see the sacred shining inside their enemies, and they stand their ground anyway.
On the other side gather the shadowed ones. Do not look for horns or darkness.
They are beautiful, luminous, elegant, and slightly wrong. The way a perfect reflection is wrong.
They cannot make light of their own, so they drink it. They are husks that attach to radiance and
feed, drawing the light in and turning it to their own ends. Wherever they pass, the brightness
dims, not with violence, but with hunger. They fight with thought alone. No weapon survives
in this density. Only the ribbons of intention arcing across the sky, the arms of thought.
And know this about the shadowed ones. They never attack. They only offer.
They whisper to what is already whispered within you. Temptation never force.
That is their whole law, and they cannot break it. And the final strangeness?
Both sides fight from their highest ideals. There is no villain here twirling his mustache.
There are only beings who have not yet realized the war is unnecessary.
Beings in whatever density, still capable of error. Watch them the way you would watch weather,
immense, slow, already passing.
